note: Re-judged 2026-10-31 by an independent auditor who authored none of the change. RFC text (rfc7947): "The route server SHOULD perform one or more BGP Decision Processes to select routes for subsequent advertisement to its clients, taking into account possible configuration to provide multiple Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI) paths to a particular client as described in Section 2.3.2.2 or multiple Loc-RIBs as described in Section 2.3.2.1." be95c10053 wraps the settings of TestRSAnnouncementAddPathClientGetsEveryPath (and the shared fixture builders) in acceptingPolicies (FinalAccept import and export, no refs) because every peer is EBGP. An accepting policy removes no path, so every path the ADD-PATH client must receive is still selected by the route server's own election. Assertions unchanged. Verdict unchanged: enforced. Earlier judgements are in this file's git history.
